tables.name: documents
tables.description: One document of a business, a team member, a space or thing, a booking or a customer (FS document row): a license, insurance, registration, background check or certificate a person gave as their own word (S1-23, S1-61, S1-81, S2-06), kept exactly as given and never checked, or an agreement, contract, estimate, proposal, design or form Rosie built for its signers to sign or OK on the secure page (S1-72, A4-43, A5-19, A5-20). There is no column that says Rosie checked, verified or approved it (FS line 736: 'No checked column'; D96; MC C4, C7). What a person gave (number, issuer, end) is sealed under the key of the person it is about. Its files are document_files rows, its words to sign document_texts rows, who must sign document_signers rows and each signature a document_signatures row. No row is ever deleted: a document taken off, replaced or not signed in time keeps its row with withdrawn_at.
tables.source: FS line 736 (document); FS line 741 (place_or_thing papers); S1-23, S1-60, S1-61, S1-72, S1-81, S2-06, S2-11, S2-28, S2-29, A4-43, A5-19, A5-20; MC C4, C7; D96; RULES 10.1 to 10.5; arch 09 line 472; 02-contracts section 7 row K-35 and section 8 (license, license_checked)

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The business whose document it is (businesses.id). Every document belongs to one business, and row-level security keeps it there: a person on two teams gives each its own, and neither sees the other's (RULES 4.10; S13-42).
columns.source: FS line 736; arch 10 line 546; RULES 4.10 ('never joined across businesses'); S13-42 ('each business's data stays with it')

columns.name: owner_kind
columns.description: Whose document it is (FS line 736's owner): business (the business's own paper, S1-23 and S1-61, or an agreement its work needs, S1-72), staff (a team member's own, S2-06, S2-11, S2-29), place_or_thing (a space's or thing's papers, S1-81), booking (a document a booking's signers sign, A4-43, A5-20) or customer (a customer's own at this business).
columns.source: FS line 736 (owner: business, staff, place_or_thing, booking, customer); FS line 741 (papers); S1-23; S1-72; S1-81; S2-06; A4-43; A5-20

columns.name: staff_person_id
columns.description: For a team member's document: that person, whose K-22 staff row at this business it belongs to (held by documents_staff_fk to staff's key business_id and person_id); null otherwise. It is also person_id, so the document is sealed under the team member's own key (documents_sealed_for_owner).
columns.source: FS line 736 (owner staff); FS line 723 (staff); S2-06; S2-11; K-22 v1 staff_business_person_key

columns.name: place_or_thing_id
columns.description: For a space's or thing's papers: the space or thing (K-23 places_or_things.id) of this business; null otherwise.
columns.source: FS line 741 (place_or_thing: papers, document ids); S1-81 ('Lists each space or thing, and its papers'); K-23 v1 places_or_things

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: For a booking's document: the booking (K-04 bookings.id, the head row) of this business; null otherwise.
columns.source: FS line 736 (owner booking); A4-43; A5-19; A5-20

columns.name: customer_person_id
columns.description: For a customer's own document at this business: that customer (persons.id); null otherwise. It is also person_id, so the document is sealed under the customer's own key (documents_sealed_for_owner).
columns.source: FS line 736 (owner customer)

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: The person the document is about, whose key in K-04's sealing_keys seals its number, issuer and end and the object keys of its files, so erasing that person's key makes them unreadable: the team member for theirs, the customer for theirs, the person who gave a business's or a place's paper (the owner or an admin: documents_paper_sealed_for_giver), and for a document Rosie built, the person it is for (the owner who signs S1-72's agreement, a booking's person served).
columns.source: arch 01 line 93; arch 09 line 492; RULES 4.10; K-04 v1 rule 6 (sealing_keys); K-22 v1 id_uploads.person_id

columns.name: kind
columns.description: license, insurance, registration, background_check, certificate, contract, estimate, proposal, design, form or agreement (FS line 736). An ID document is never one: the owner's ID upload is K-22's id_uploads (MC C10).
columns.source: FS line 736 (kind); S1-23 ('any license, insurance or document'); S1-61 (registration); S2-28, S2-29 (background check, certificate); A5-19 ('A document is a contract, a written estimate, a proposal or a design'); A4-43 (form); S1-72 (agreement); MC C10

columns.name: title
columns.description: What the document is called: the plug-in's name for the paper (S1-60: the plug-in names the licenses) or the kind's own name, such as Barber license or Health privacy agreement. Never words the person typed: those are sealed in number, issuer and ends. It is shown as the business's own word, never as checked (S13-11).
columns.source: FS line 736 (name or number); S1-60 ('The plug-in names the licenses and who issues them'); S2-06 ('Barber license: as you gave it, not checked'); S13-11

columns.name: number
columns.description: The paper's number exactly as the person gave it (the quoted words of their text, or the page's field), never parsed or corrected, sealed under person_id's key: a license number is personal data. Customers see it only as the business's own word, where shown_on_listing is true or the plug-in's rules want it on the job (S13-13); a team member's read-back says 'as you gave it', never the number (S2-06). Null: none given, or a document Rosie built.
columns.source: FS line 736 (name or number); S1-23 ('BS20981'; 'It shows as you gave it; Rosie doesn't check it'); S1-61 ('Registration 2020-1187'); S2-06; S13-11; S13-13; RULES 10.1; arch 01 line 93

columns.name: issuer
columns.description: Who issued it (a state, a city or the federal government, or for insurance its carrier), exactly as given, sealed under person_id's key. Shown as number is. Null: not given, or a document Rosie built.
columns.source: FS line 736 (issuer); S1-60 ('who issues them: a state, a city or the federal government'); RULES 10.4; S1-23 ('Insurance or a bond may be added here too')

columns.name: ends
columns.description: Its end date exactly as the person gave it (their words, such as 06/2027), sealed under person_id's key. Rosie never reads it as a date, since no lapse is checked while switch verify is off (MC C4: S2-11's Expired branch is hidden), so it holds no instant and no zone. Shown as number is. Null: not given, or a document Rosie built.
columns.source: FS line 736 (end_date); MC C4; RULES 10.5; S2-11 ('With checks on, Rosie checks the name, kind, status, places and end date')

columns.name: shown_on_listing
columns.description: Whether customers see it on the listing and with the work it is for, always as the business's own word, never as checked (S1-23: 'to show customers'; S2-06: 'Any license you want shown'; S13-11). Set by the person it is about or the owner.
columns.source: FS line 736 (shown_on_listing); S1-23; S2-06; S13-11; RULES 10.1; 01-inventory C-196 ('documents only as added by the business')

columns.name: origin
columns.description: given: a person gave it as their own word (S1-23, S1-61, S1-81, S2-06), kept exactly as given and never checked; built: Rosie built it from the plug-in's and the owner's parts for its signers to sign or OK on the secure page (S1-72, A4-43, A5-20).
columns.source: S1-23; S1-61; S2-06; S1-72; A5-20 ('Rosie builds the document from the price and the parts the plug-in and the owner require'); MC C7

columns.name: given_by_person_id
columns.description: For a given document: who gave it (persons.id), the person it is about, the owner or an admin; null for one Rosie built.
columns.source: S1-23; S1-81; S2-06; RULES 10.1 ('as the business gave it')

columns.name: given_via
columns.description: For a given document: where it was given: chat (their own chat with Rosie, by text: S1-23's 'Send it', S1-61), secure_page (the person's secure page, S2-06) or portal (the owner console). Never by a call, since nothing goes by voice (DL-029). Null for one Rosie built.
columns.source: S1-23 ('by text or a call, or on the secure page'); S1-61; S2-06; 02-contracts K-21 (owner console: Documents); DL-029

columns.name: added_at
columns.description: When it was given, or built and sent to its signers: an instant in UTC (CQ-09), shown in the business's zone (K-04 businesses.time_zone), or for a booking's document in the visit's zone (S13-03; CQ-05).

columns.name: signed_by_all_at
columns.description: For a document Rosie built: when the last signer it asks signed (A5-20's 'All signed'; S1-72's 'Signed'), set in the commit that writes that signature; null until then, and always for a given document. The money step waits for it (A5-20), and Go live reads a business's agreement with none as left unsigned (S1-29). Shown in the zone added_at is.
columns.source: FS line 736 (signers and signed_at); A5-20 ('The money step comes only once everyone has signed'); S1-72; S1-29 ('2 Left unsigned')

columns.name: withdrawn_at
columns.description: When it stopped counting and showing; the row stays, since records are kept (RULES 4.10; S13-08). Null: it stands. Shown in the zone added_at is.
columns.source: RULES 10.1 ('A business adds what it wants, or none'); S2-06 ('2 Fix something'); A5-23; RULES 4.10; S13-08

columns.name: withdrawn_why
columns.description: taken_off (the person or the owner took it off), replaced (a new one was given in its place: a correction is a new document, never an edit of what was given) or not_signed_in_time (a document Rosie built that not everyone signed before the saved time ended, so the time was let go: A5-20, A5-23). Null while it stands.
columns.source: RULES 10.1; S2-06; A5-20 ('Not signed in time'); A5-23 ('Not everyone signed in time: the time is let go')

columns.name: withdrawn_by_person_id
columns.description: Who took it off or replaced it (persons.id); null when Rosie let it go because it was not signed in time, and while it stands.
columns.source: RULES 10.1; A5-23

columns.name: version
columns.description: The row's version: every update raises it by one, and a commit compares and sets it, so a write made from an old read is refused with the rows that changed (limit 4).
columns.source: arch 01 line 85; arch 10 line 506; K-04 v1 rule 2

checks.name: documents_sealed_for_owner

checks.name: documents_given_by_whom
checks.expression: (origin = 'given' and given_by_person_id is not null and given_via is not null) or (origin = 'built' and given_by_person_id is null and given_via is null)
checks.source: RULES 10.1 ('as the business gave it'); S1-23; S2-06; A5-20 ('Rosie builds the document')

checks.name: documents_given_via_known
checks.expression: given_via is null or given_via in ('chat', 'secure_page', 'portal')

checks.name: documents_built_to_sign
checks.source: A5-19 ('A document is a contract, a written estimate, a proposal or a design'); A4-43 (forms); S1-72 (agreement)

checks.name: documents_built_holds_no_given_values
checks.expression: origin = 'given' or (number is null and issuer is null and ends is null)

checks.name: documents_paper_sealed_for_giver
checks.expression: origin = 'built' or owner_kind not in ('business', 'place_or_thing') or person_id = given_by_person_id

checks.name: documents_signed_only_built
checks.expression: signed_by_all_at is null or (origin = 'built' and signed_by_all_at >= added_at)

checks.name: documents_withdrawn_with_why
checks.expression: (withdrawn_at is null) = (withdrawn_why is null) and (withdrawn_at is null or withdrawn_at >= added_at)

checks.name: documents_withdrawn_why_known
checks.expression: withdrawn_why is null or withdrawn_why in ('taken_off', 'replaced', 'not_signed_in_time')

checks.name: documents_withdrawn_by_whom
checks.expression: case when withdrawn_why is null then withdrawn_by_person_id is null else (withdrawn_why = 'not_signed_in_time') = (withdrawn_by_person_id is null) end
checks.source: RULES 10.1; A5-23 (Rosie lets the time go)

checks.name: documents_not_signed_only_built
checks.expression: withdrawn_why is distinct from 'not_signed_in_time' or (origin = 'built' and signed_by_all_at is null)

tables.name: document_files
tables.description: A file of a given document: a photo or a file such as a PDF the person uploaded with it (a license photo, an insurance certificate), kept private in R2 behind the files port (K-13). The row holds only the file's object key, sealed under the key of the document's person, never the file or its bytes. Files are taken only on the secure page or in the portal, never from the chat (S13-43: 'A license photo goes only on the secure page'; MC C10). Written once: never edited or deleted by the application.
tables.source: FS line 736 (file (secure)); MC 8 'Files' (uploads stay private in R2); MC C10; S13-43; RULES 4.5; Q-31; 02-contracts K-13 (signed uploads: license file, form, signed document)

tables.name: document_texts
tables.description: The exact words of a document Rosie built, as its signers read them, each in their own language from a checked text (A5-20; RULES 4.11): the words, their sha256 and the checked text's version. One per document and language, written once and never edited, so each signature names exactly the words it signed. Never sealed: a signature's proof survives a person's key being deleted, as its hash and the words shown (arch 09 line 492; RULES 4.10), as K-29's consent words do.
tables.source: A5-20 ('Each signer reads it in their own language, from a checked text'); S1-72; RULES 4.10, 4.11; S13-08 ('contracts and every yes are kept 7 years'); arch 09 line 492; FS line 754
